# FatSecret fixtures

`spanakopita_detail.json` and `bigmac_detail.json` were recorded from the platform on
2026-09-24 (`scripts/food-source-eval --record`): the Athens Spanakopita detail (one serving
"2 pieces", 56 g, 140 kcal) and the McDonald's Big Mac detail ("1 serving", no weight,
580 kcal). The two `*_search.json` files are authored in the platform's shape from the rows
that recording returned (ids, names, brands and types as recorded; descriptions abbreviated):
the recorder had overwritten them with error 21 bodies while the platform still refused this
Mac's IP, and it now refuses to write a refusal. `token.json` and `ip_error.json` are
authored from the documented shapes. Re-record all four with `scripts/food-source-eval
--record` once the IP is allowed everywhere.
